blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Newly appointed Public Works and Highways Secretary Giovanni Lopez on Tuesday vowed to continue and strengthen the reforms in the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH). Lopez made the commitment a day after the latest Cabinet revamp, where he was appointed to lead the DPWH, replacing Secretary Vince Dizon in turn took over Lopez’ post as transportation secretary. Lopez emphasized that since reforms have already been made inside the DPWH amid the corruption issues it faces, it is important to make them last, regardless of who sits as the president and secretary of the agency.
